items.name: Fire Monk Ashes

items.name: Giant Rat Ashes

items.name: Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Ashes

items.name: "Homing Instinct" Painting
items.acquisitionText: Use the spiritspring while facing southeast to reach a shack. Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] next to it and interact with the painting inside for the "Homing Instinct" Painting.

items.name: "Resurrection" Painting
items.acquisitionText: Grab the Artist's Shack grace at the top of the slope, then interact with the painting in the shack to get the "Resurrection" Painting.

items.name: "Champion's Song" Painting
items.acquisitionText: Enter the wooden structure near the pond and interact with the painting to obtain the "Champion's Song" Painting.

items.name: "Redmane" Painting
items.acquisitionText: Follow the road near Gowry's shack until you see a red painting beneath a balcony on the right. Examine it to receive the "Redmane" Painting.

items.name: "Sorcerer" Painting
items.acquisitionText: Descend the ladder and grab the "Sorcerer" Painting, as well as a shortcut door to the lower section.

items.name: "Incursion" Painting
items.acquisitionText: At the end of the woods are two paths. Climb the rocky slope first to grab the "Incursion" Painting from the shack at the top.

items.name: "The Sacred Tower" Painting
items.acquisitionText: Return to the Scorched Ruins and head northeast to an opening in the cliff and grab "The Sacred Tower" Painting inside.

items.name: "Domain of Dragons" Painting
items.acquisitionText: Behind the waterfall you passed is a ladder that leads to a painting. Examine it to obtain the "Domain of Dragons" Painting.
